statement: ∀ (v : Fin 2 → ℝ), v ∈ LinearMap.ker alpha ↔ v 1 = -2 * v 0
script:
# name: la-mem-ker-alpha-test
# technique: test a claim no recipe certifies, at instances the kernel checks by computation (test_fallback)
# goal: sage_test KaluzaKlein.LinearAlgebra.LinearFunctionals.mem_ker_alpha file "la-mem-ker-alpha-test.sage"
# description: v ∈ ker α ↔ y = −2x at the origin, at (1, −2) and at (1, 1) (both sides false), by evaluation.
SEED = 0  # EDIT: the sampler's seed, kept in the test record
PROOF = 'rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]\nnorm_num [alpha]'  # EDIT: the tactic block proving the claim at one instance
CASES = [  # EDIT: the instances as ([values as Lean text], edge?[, proof]) tuples
    (['0'], True),
    (['![1, -2]'], False),
    (['![1, 1]'], False),
]
cases = CASES
instances = [kernel_instance(*c[0], proof=c[2] if len(c) > 2 else PROOF, edge=c[1]) for c in cases]
